description: Defines the IShape interface and extension methods for dynamic shape manipulation within OrchardCore's display management system.

classes.name: IShape
classes.description: Interface for dynamic shapes, providing properties and methods for shape attributes and content.

classes.name: IShapeExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods for IShape, including property access, shape building, and JSON serialization.

methods.name: IsNullOrEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the shape is null or a ZoneOnDemand.

methods.name: TryGetProperty
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a property of type T from the shape's properties.

methods.name: GetProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a property value by key, with overloads for default values and type casting.

methods.name: AddRangeAsync
methods.description: Adds multiple items asynchronously to the shape.

methods.name: AddAsync
methods.description: Adds a single item asynchronously to the shape.

methods.name: GetTagBuilder
methods.description: Creates a TagBuilder object based on shape attributes, classes, and ID.

methods.name: ShapeToJson
methods.description: Serializes the shape to a JSON object.
